info.title: TraceMason v0.1.2 · Implementation contract
info.description: v0.1.2 five-module gateway design. Management authentication added; prior account APIs now require session. Schema describes planned service, not deployed implementation. Raw forwarding and optional redacted evidence collection are independent.
